questions: Which site location should I use to assess weather-dependent cooling and cold storage? (If you do not know: Use Amsterdam Schiphol weather, as stated in the input assumptions..)
final_reply:
The cheapest design found is €31.78/MWh, with €40.24 million capital cost and €4.303 million annual cost. It meets every day of the stated heating and cooling demand; GEMINI confirms the required 100°C supply at both demand peaks. [R1033]

The plant uses two 3,010 m doublets, a 0.75 MW gas boiler, a 10 MW screw chiller with dry cooler, 0.9 MW electrical CHP and 0.35 MW electrical ORC. Variable-speed pumps are rated at 220 m³/h; heating/cooling returns are 45/29°C. [R1033]
